definitions.gloss: wakame, a type of edible seaweed
definitions.explanation: A brown seaweed widely used in Japanese cuisine, especially in miso soup and salads.

examples.japanese: わかめを{水|みず}で{戻|もど}す。
{味噌汁|みそしる}にわかめを{入|い}れる。
examples.english: To put wakame in miso soup.

examples.japanese: わかめは{栄養|えいよう}が{豊富|ほうふ}で{毎日|まいにち}の{食事|しょくじ}に{取|と}り{入|い}れやすい。
examples.english: Wakame is rich in nutrients and easy to incorporate into daily meals.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. The kanji {若布|わかめ} or {和布|わかめ} exists but is uncommon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・わかめの{味噌汁|みそしる} (wakame miso soup)
・わかめサラダ (wakame salad)
・{乾燥|かんそう}わかめ (dried wakame)
・わかめを{水|みず}で{戻|もど}す (to rehydrate dried wakame)

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the most commonly eaten seaweeds in Japan. Dried wakame ({乾燥|かんそう}わかめ) is a pantry staple that can be rehydrated quickly. Distinct from {昆布|こんぶ} (kelp) and {海苔|のり} (nori).
